response.original_title: [Dispute-Guide] Freedom of the Seas Cruise Dispute Number: Customer Service & Resolution Guide
response.overview: You can reach Royal Caribbean's post-cruise assistance and billing support for Freedom of the Seas at 1-866-254-7549 or text/call 1-866-254-7549 through Royal Caribbean Contact Us.How to Dispute a Charge Prepare information: Gather your reservation details, sail dates, and your SeaPass statement 1-866-254-7549. Review charges: Compare your SeaPass receipts with your personal bank 1-866-254-7549 or credit card statements. Reach out: Contact customer service by phone 1-866-254-7549 or via royalguestrelations@rccl.com to initiate a billing inquiry, and ask for a supervisor if further escalation is needed.
